#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Real Vivado source build runner; no board operations or model requests."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def sources():
    result = {}
    for folder in [ROOT / "src", ROOT / "third_party", ROOT / "build"]:
        for path in sorted(folder.rglob("*")):
            if path.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in path.parts:
                if path.suffix.lower() in {".dcp", ".xpr", ".bit", ".xsa", ".xclbin", ".so", ".o"}:
                    raise ValueError("Generated binary found among source inputs: " + str(path))
                result[path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--vivado", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--vitis-root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--stage", choices=["prepare", "implement", "all"], default="all")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    out = args.out.resolve()
    if out == ROOT or ROOT in out.parents:
        raise ValueError("Output must be outside the source directory")
    if args.stage != "implement" and out.exists():
        raise ValueError("Use a fresh output directory")
    vivado = args.vivado.resolve()
    vitis = args.vitis_root.resolve()
    if not vivado.is_file() or not (vitis / "data/ip").is_dir():
        raise ValueError("Vivado executable or Vitis IP directory missing")
    pins = sources()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=args.stage == "implement")
    previous = out / "prepare_receipt.json"
    if args.stage == "implement":
        prepared = json.loads(previous.read_text())
        if prepared.get("exit_code") != 0 or prepared.get("source_sha256") != pins:
            raise ValueError("Source differs from successful prepare; start a fresh build")
    command = [str(vivado), "-mode", "batch", "-source", str(ROOT / "build/build.tcl"),
               "-log", str(out / (args.stage + ".vivado.log")),
               "-journal", str(out / (args.stage + ".vivado.jou")),
               "-tclargs", "--out", str(out), "--stage", args.stage, "--vitis-root", str(vitis)]
    started = time.time()
    log = out / (args.stage + ".console.log")
    print("Running stage", args.stage, "log:", log, flush=True)
    with log.open("wb") as handle:
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=out, stdout=handle, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                   env=dict(os.environ, OMP_NUM_THREADS="1"))
        code = process.wait()
    required = []
    if args.stage in {"prepare", "all"}:
        required += ["AUAR_PREPARE_PASS"]
    if args.stage in {"implement", "all"}:
        required += ["AUAR_IMPLEMENT_PASS"]
    text = log.read_text(errors="replace")
    missing = [marker for marker in required if marker not in text]
    changed = pins != sources()
    receipt = {"stage": args.stage, "exit_code": code, "elapsed_seconds": round(time.time() - started, 3),
               "missing_markers": missing, "source_changed": changed, "source_sha256": pins,
               "command": command, "old_checkpoint_used": False, "board_accessed": False,
               "status": "PASS" if code == 0 and not missing and not changed else "FAIL"}
    (out / (args.stage + "_receipt.json")).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in receipt.items() if key not in {"source_sha256", "command"}}, indent=2))
    return 0 if receipt["status"] == "PASS" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
        print("ERROR:", str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)

# Invoke with Vivado, not directly as a shell executable.
# vivado -mode batch -source build/build.tcl -tclargs --out NEW_DIR --stage all --vitis-root VITIS_DIR
set ::AUAR_ROOT [file dirname [file dirname [file normalize [info script]]]]
proc auar_main {} {
    set args [dict create --stage all]
    if {[llength $::argv] % 2} {error "Arguments must be key/value pairs"}
    foreach {key value} $::argv {
        if {$key ni {--out --stage --vitis-root}} {error "Unknown argument $key"}
        dict set args $key $value
    }
    foreach key {--out --vitis-root} {
        if {![dict exists $args $key]} {error "Missing required argument $key"}
    }
    set out [file normalize [dict get $args --out]]
    set vitis [file normalize [dict get $args --vitis-root]]
    set stage [dict get $args --stage]
    if {$stage ni {prepare implement all}} {error "Unknown stage $stage"}
    set root $::AUAR_ROOT
    if {$out eq $root || [string first "$root/" "$out/"] == 0} {
        error "Build output must be outside the source directory"
    }
    if {![string match "2022.2*" [version -short]]} {error "This release requires Vivado 2022.2"}
    set_param general.maxThreads 1
    file mkdir [file join $out reports]
    if {$stage in {prepare all}} {
        if {[file exists [file join $out project platform.xpr]]} {error "Refusing to overwrite an existing project"}
        source [file join $root src fpga ip ip_config.tcl]
        auar_configure_ips $root $out $vitis
        source [file join $root src fpga bd create_bd.tcl]
        set bd [get_files */kv260_ispMipiRx_vcu_DP.bd]
        add_files -fileset constrs_1 -norecurse [file join $root src fpga constraints pins.xdc]
        generate_target all $bd
        add_files -norecurse [make_wrapper -files $bd -top]
        set_property top kv260_ispMipiRx_vcu_DP_wrapper [current_fileset]
        update_compile_order -fileset sources_1
        write_bd_tcl -force [file join $out reports reconstructed_bd.tcl]
        report_ip_status -file [file join $out reports ip_status.rpt]
        close_project
        puts "AUAR_PREPARE_PASS"
    }
    if {$stage in {implement all}} {
        open_project [file join $out project platform.xpr]
        set bd [get_files */kv260_ispMipiRx_vcu_DP.bd]
        create_ip_run $bd
        launch_runs synth_1 -jobs 1
        wait_on_run synth_1
        if {[get_property PROGRESS [get_runs synth_1]] ne "100%"} {
            error "Synthesis failed: [get_property STATUS [get_runs synth_1]]"
        }
        open_run synth_1
        set pad [get_ports servo_pwm]
        foreach {prop expected} {PACKAGE_PIN E10 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS33 DRIVE 8 SLEW SLOW DIRECTION OUT} {
            if {[get_property $prop $pad] ne $expected} {error "PWM pad mismatch $prop"}
        }
        set regs [get_cells -hier -filter {NAME =~ */aura_m3_regs_0/* && IS_SEQUENTIAL}]
        if {![llength $regs]} {error "Motion registers absent from synthesis"}
        set_max_delay 100.0 -datapath_only -from $regs -to $pad
        opt_design
        # Deliberately no old/incremental read_checkpoint input.
        place_design -directive Explore
        phys_opt_design -directive AggressiveExplore
        route_design -directive AggressiveExplore
        phys_opt_design -directive AggressiveExplore
        set reports [file join $out reports]
        report_timing_summary -delay_type min_max -report_unconstrained -max_paths 10 -file [file join $reports timing.rpt]
        report_utilization -file [file join $reports utilization.rpt]
        report_route_status -file [file join $reports route.rpt]
        report_drc -file [file join $reports drc.rpt]
        report_clocks -file [file join $reports clocks.rpt]
        check_timing -verbose -file [file join $reports check_timing.rpt]
        set setup [get_timing_paths -delay_type max -max_paths 1]
        set hold [get_timing_paths -delay_type min -max_paths 1]
        if {![llength $setup] || ![llength $hold]} {error "Setup/hold paths missing"}
        set wns [get_property SLACK $setup]
        set whs [get_property SLACK $hold]
        set errors [get_drc_violations -quiet -filter {SEVERITY == Error}]
        set f [open [file join $reports implementation.json] w]
        puts $f "{\"wns_ns\":$wns,\"whs_ns\":$whs,\"drc_errors\":[llength $errors],\"old_checkpoint_used\":false,\"board_verified\":false}"
        close $f
        if {$wns < 0 || $whs < 0 || [llength $errors]} {error "Implementation timing/DRC failed"}
        set checkpoint [file join $out auar_source_routed.dcp]
        write_checkpoint $checkpoint
        close_project
        # Export from THIS run's checkpoint in non-project mode.
        open_checkpoint $checkpoint
        write_bitstream -bin_file [file join $out auar_source.bit]
        write_hw_platform -fixed -include_bit [file join $out auar_source.xsa]
        validate_hw_platform -verbose [file join $out auar_source.xsa]
        close_project
        puts "AUAR_IMPLEMENT_PASS"
    }
}
if {[catch {auar_main} why options]} {
    puts stderr "AUAR_BUILD_FAILED: $why"
    if {[dict exists $options -errorinfo]} {puts stderr [dict get $options -errorinfo]}
    exit 1
}
exit 0

Please run the script in Vivado <$scripts_vivado_version> then open the design in Vivado <$current_vivado_version>. Upgrade the design by running \"Tools => Report => Report IP Status...\", then run write_bd_tcl to create an updated script."}

   # USE CASES:

   set errMsg "Please set the variable <design_name> to a non-empty value."

} elseif { ${cur_design} ne "" && ${list_cells} eq "" } {
   # USE CASES:
   #    2): Current design opened AND is empty AND names same.

   if { $cur_design ne $design_name } {
      common::send_gid_msg -ssname BD::TCL -id 2001 -severity "INFO" "Changing value of <design_name> from <$design_name> to <$cur_design> since current design is empty."

   }
   common::send_gid_msg -ssname BD::TCL -id 2002 -severity "INFO" "Constructing design in IPI design <$cur_design>..."

} elseif { ${cur_design} ne "" && $list_cells ne "" && $cur_design eq $design_name } {
   # USE CASES:
   #    5) Current design opened AND has components AND same names.

   set errMsg "Design <$design_name> already exists in your project, please set the variable <design_name> to another value."
   set nRet 1
} elseif { [get_files -quiet ${design_name}.bd] ne "" } {
   # USE CASES: 
   #    6) Current opened design, has components, but diff names, design_name exists in project.
   #    7) No opened design, design_name exists in project.

   set errMsg "Design <$design_name> already exists in your project, please set the variable <design_name> to another value."

   # USE CASES:
   #    8) No opened design, design_name not in project.

   common::send_gid_msg -ssname BD::TCL -id 2003 -severity "INFO" "Currently there is no design <$design_name> in project, so creating one..."

   common::send_gid_msg -ssname BD::TCL -id 2004 -severity "INFO" "Making design <$design_name> as current_bd_design."
   current_bd_design $design_name

}

common::send_gid_msg -ssname BD::TCL -id 2005 -severity "INFO" "Currently the variable <design_name> is equal to \"$design_name\"."

if { $nRet != 0 } {
   catch {common::send_gid_msg -ssname BD::TCL -id 2006 -severity "ERROR" $errMsg}

  variable script_folder

  if { $parentCell eq "" || $nameHier eq "" } {
     catch {common::send_gid_msg -ssname BD::TCL -id 2092 -severity "ERROR" "create_hier_cell_vcu() - Empty argument(s)!"}
     return
  }

  # Get object for parentCell
  set parentObj [get_bd_cells $parentCell]
  if { $parentObj == "" } {
     catch {common::send_gid_msg -ssname BD::TCL -id 2090 -severity "ERROR" "Unable to find parent cell <$parentCell>!"}
     return
  }

  # Make sure parentObj is hier blk
  set parentType [get_property TYPE $parentObj]
  if { $parentType ne "hier" } {
     catch {common::send_gid_msg -ssname BD::TCL -id 2091 -severity "ERROR" "Parent <$parentObj> has TYPE = <$parentType>. Expected to be <hier>."}
     return

  # Save current instance; Restore later
  set oldCurInst [current_bd_instance .]

  current_bd_instance $parentObj

  # Create cell and set as current instance
  set hier_obj [create_bd_cell -type hier $nameHier]

  # Create interface pins
  create_bd_intf_pin -mode Master -vlnv xilinx.com:interface:aximm_rtl:1.0 M00_AXI_VCU_DEC

    CONFIG.NUM_SI {2} \

    CONFIG.S01_HAS_REGSLICE {1} \

    CONFIG.DEC_COLOR_FORMAT {0} \
    CONFIG.DEC_FPS {1} \
    CONFIG.DEC_FRAME_SIZE {4} \

    CONFIG.ENC_BUFFER_EN {true} \
    CONFIG.ENC_BUFFER_MANUAL_OVERRIDE {1} \
    CONFIG.ENC_BUFFER_SIZE {253} \
    CONFIG.ENC_BUFFER_SIZE_ACTUAL {284} \
    CONFIG.ENC_BUFFER_TYPE {0} \
    CONFIG.ENC_CODING_TYPE {1} \
    CONFIG.ENC_COLOR_DEPTH {0} \
    CONFIG.ENC_COLOR_FORMAT {0} \
    CONFIG.ENC_FPS {1} \
    CONFIG.ENC_FRAME_SIZE {4} \
    CONFIG.ENC_MEM_BRAM_USED {0} \
    CONFIG.ENC_MEM_URAM_USED {284} \
    CONFIG.NO_OF_DEC_STREAMS {1} \
    CONFIG.NO_OF_STREAMS {1} \
    CONFIG.TABLE_NO {2} \
  ] $vcu_0


  # Create instance: xlslice_0, and set properties
  set xlslice_0 [ create_bd_cell -type ip -vlnv xilinx.com:ip:xlslice:1.0 xlslice_0 ]
  set_property -dict [list \
    CONFIG.DIN_FROM {2} \
    CONFIG.DIN_TO {2} \

  connect_bd_intf_net -intf_net S00_AXI_2 [get_bd_intf_pins axi_ic_vcu_dec/S00_AXI] [get_bd_intf_pins vcu_0/M_AXI_DEC0]

  # Create port connections
  connect_bd_net -net Din_1 [get_bd_pins Din] [get_bd_pins xlslice_0/Din]
  connect_bd_net -net clk_wiz_0_clk_100M [get_bd_pins s_axi_lite_aclk] [get_bd_pins vcu_0/s_axi_lite_aclk]
